basic_profile.bio: A 31-year-old night owl living in Quebec City, working as a freelance graphic designer. I enjoy late-night drives, exploring local eateries, and am an advocate for body positivity. A fan of spontaneous adventures, I often spend my nights getting lost in Reddit, particularly threads that challenge me or make me laugh. I'm single, and my typical online hours are from 10 PM to 4 AM. In my spare time, I love visiting natural hot springs and learning about different cultures, especially Turkish traditions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a formal education in Graphic Design from a local college, I have honed my skills through years of freelance work, particularly in branding and digital media. Additionally, I've self-taught myself various design software and keep up with trends via online forums and courses.
